777.speaker: Narrator
777.text: The Brenas police officers didn't budge.

778.speaker: Narrator
778.text: A few officers began ineffectually trying to shepherd the students back to their seats.

779.speaker: Narrator
779.text: Rico and I watched as the auditorium gradually emptied out.

782.speaker: Narrator
782.text: He signaled to his guards to block the exit. Members of Lucita's Central Police force joined them.

789.speaker: Narrator
789.text: Only a few people remained seated. One of them was Vina.

790.speaker: Narrator
790.text: He signaled to his other guards. They swiftly blocked the exit.

794.speaker: Narrator

802.speaker: Narrator

811.speaker: Narrator
811.text: Holding eye contact with me, he rose from his chair, turned around and left the room as well.

815.speaker: Player_Romus
815.text: "Our kingdom is at a turning point. We face countless enemies, and the most dangerous of all are those within our own borders."

816.speaker: Player_Romus
816.text: "These are perilous times. We are at risk of being destroyed by the nefarious forces outside our door."

817.speaker: Player_Romus
817.text: "Our enemies tried to destroy us from within in the '20s. Little did they know Rizia would end up stronger than ever."

818.speaker: Player_Romus
818.text: "As your King, I am relying on your support to defeat Pales once and for all."

819.speaker: Player_Romus
819.text: "I am relying on you all to uphold Rizia's reputation."

820.speaker: Player_Romus
820.text: "With God on our side, we will overcome every challenge."

824.speaker: Player_Romus
824.text: "I implore you to hold fast to your Rizian identity. Remember the values upon which this nation was built."

828.speaker: Player_Romus
828.text: "Time and time again, the Toras family has led Rizia out of crisis. With your help, we will do so again."

829.speaker: Player_Romus
829.text: "Rizian, Wehzek, Derdian, Valgish -- I call on all subjects of the Crown to unite as one."

830.speaker: Player_Romus
830.text: "If you learn one thing here, it should be to trust in the superiority of your King and your ruling house."

831.speaker: Player_Romus
831.text: "We shall go forth from these halls and fight for our country! Crush anyone who stands in our way!"

835.speaker: Player_Romus
835.text: "I promise you, we will prosper as never before!"

839.speaker: Player_Romus
839.text: "We will form new alliances and take our rightful place on the global stage!"

840.speaker: Player_Romus
840.text: "We will show the whole world that monarchies still matter!"

841.speaker: Player_Romus
841.text: "We will restore the glory days of our golden kingdom!"

842.speaker: Narrator
842.text: Rico firmly applauded from his seat.

847.speaker: Narrator
847.text: My cousin stood bolt upright with his hand over his heart.

853.speaker: Player_Romus
853.text: "God bless you all, and God bless Rizia!"

855.speaker: Narrator
855.text: Thunderous cheers came from the Su Omina section of the audience. Everyone else applauded politely.

856.speaker: Player_Romus
856.text: "Lead the way. I'm done with this shitshow."

857.speaker: Player_Romus
857.text: "No, I want to see what happens. I am staying."

858.speaker: Player_Romus
858.text: "Get Vina out, too. She could be in danger."

868.speaker: Narrator
868.text: He gestured to Vina. She shook her head.

873.speaker: Narrator
873.text: One of his guardsmen rushed to the VIP row and pulled Vina and Manus towards the stage.

874.speaker: Narrator
874.text: One of his guardsmen rushed to the VIP row and pulled Vina towards the stage.

875.speaker: Vina Toras
875.text: "Get your hands off me! I don't need your protection."

877.speaker: Narrator
877.text: I could still hear the sound of shouts and fistfights as Rico and I followed Titus and his guards through the back door.

878.speaker: Narrator
878.text: A shot suddenly rang out, followed by ear-splitting cries.

879.speaker: Narrator
879.text: The crowd had spread out into a circle. In the middle, splayed across the auditorium stairs, was the body of a student.

880.speaker: Narrator
880.text: Titus grabbed my wrist. I saw his men do the same with Vina.

886.speaker: Narrator
886.text: The crowd's screams echoed in my ears as we disappeared through the back door.

887.speaker: Player_Romus
887.text: "I would therefore like to announce that I am removing Ricardus Toras from power. Effective immediately."

888.speaker: Narrator
888.text: The audience roared. Rico shot out of his seat.

890.speaker: Narrator
890.text: Titus grabbed his shoulders and forced him back into his chair.

894.speaker: Narrator
894.text: The audience's chatter had escalated into a cacophony. I motioned for silence.

898.speaker: Narrator
898.text: The audience's chatter had escalated into a cacophony. I motioned for silence.

899.speaker: Narrator
899.text: Many wore outfits adorned with the Iza University mascot, an anthropomorphic cactus named Spikey.

900.speaker: Narrator
900.text: The protesters surged towards the blocked doors.

901.speaker: Narrator
901.text: By sheer numbers, they managed to overpower the guards and squeeze out of the building.

905.speaker: Narrator
905.text: Some of the younger students began fighting with the guards. Before long, a full-on brawl had broken out.

906.speaker: Titus Gordion
906.text: "We have to get you out of here. There's a back exit."

907.speaker: Narrator
907.text: The university dean was still on stage with us. She looked at me questioningly.

909.speaker: Player_Romus
909.text: "I had an ending prepared, but I don't think you're going to like it."

910.speaker: Player_Romus
910.text: "So, Iza has shown its true colors."

911.speaker: Narrator
911.text: Rico buried his head in his hands.

912.speaker: Player_Romus
912.text: "I hope you're happy with what you've done to this city, Rico."

913.speaker: Player_Romus
913.text: "This is more than just student hijinks. Our international enemies have had a hand in it."

914.speaker: Player_Romus
914.text: "A little rebellion is normal at that age. Nothing to be worried about."

917.speaker: Rico Toras
917.text: "If you'd just given me the resources to do my job--"

918.speaker: Rico Toras
918.text: "They just walked out on both their king and duke. If that's normal, we're in trouble."

920.speaker: Narrator
920.text: As we left the building, the splatters of red on the students' shirts remained seared into my consciousness.

924.speaker: Narrator
924.text: How much real blood would be spilled before my reign ended?

925.speaker: Narrator
925.text: As we left the building, the capital letters on the students' shirts remained seared into my consciousness.

926.speaker: Narrator
926.text: Romus the Oppressor. Had my legacy already been spelled out for me?

931.speaker: Narrator
931.text: A hush came over the crowd as my announcement sank in.

932.speaker: Narrator
932.text: Hesitantly, the students and teachers assembled began clapping.

939.speaker: Narrator
939.text: Vina sat still. She wasn't applauding at all.

940.speaker: Narrator
940.text: Vina and Manus both sat still. They weren't applauding at all.

944.speaker: Narrator
944.text: I looked at the House Sazon members in the audience. They weren't applauding at all.

945.speaker: Narrator
945.text: Manus sat still. He wasn't applauding at all.

946.speaker: Narrator
946.text: The House Sazon nobles in the audience applauded politely. I saw steel in their eyes.

947.speaker: Narrator
947.text: With fear in their eyes, the students and teachers assembled began clapping.

950.speaker: Narrator
950.text: The auditorium reverberated with thunderous applause.

958.speaker: Narrator
958.text: Rico was still frozen to his seat. He seemed to be processing everything that had happened.

959.speaker: Narrator
959.text: I looked over once more at the empty seat where Rico had been.

960.speaker: Narrator
960.text: He was right. Hugo wouldn't stand for this.

961.speaker: Narrator
961.text: But with House Sazon on my side, perhaps I could still weather the storm.

964.speaker: Player_Romus
964.text: "Peace has come to Iza at last!"

975.speaker: Narrator
975.text: But with the people on my side, perhaps I could still weather the storm.

979.speaker: Narrator
979.text: But perhaps I could still weather the storm.

980.speaker: Narrator
980.text: I sat back down next to Rico.

982.speaker: Player_Romus
982.text: "I am quite the compelling public speaker, aren't I?"

983.speaker: Player_Romus
983.text: "They hate us, Rico. They're just too afraid to express it."

985.speaker: Player_Romus
985.text: "I was just repairing the damage from your speech."

986.speaker: Rico Toras
986.text: "A pity the audience wasn't more appreciative."

987.speaker: Rico Toras
987.text: "One person got upset. Everyone else loved me."

988.speaker: Player_Romus
988.text: "I'm just happy that I can go home now."

990.speaker: Narrator
990.text: The celebratory speeches wrapped up, and Titus and his guards escorted us out of the auditorium's back entrance.

991.speaker: Narrator
991.text: As we were exiting, I noticed a van parked around the corner from the building. Muffled screams were emanating from it.

992.speaker: Narrator
992.text: It sounded like the voice of the student who had been dragged away by Su Omina earlier.

996.speaker: Narrator
996.text: It sounded like the voice of the student who had shouted at Rico earlier.

997.speaker: Narrator
997.text: Titus led us away from the source of the sound towards the university gardens, where a lavish banquet awaited us.

1001.speaker: Player_Romus
1001.text: "Still, I ask you to have patience. Your duke is young, and has much to learn."

1002.speaker: Player_Romus
1002.text: "I have heard your calls for a change of leadership in this city. And I take them seriously."

1003.speaker: Player_Romus
1003.text: "I have faith that the good city of Iza will embrace peace and progress. Even with Duke Ricardus nominally holding the reins."

1007.speaker: Player_Romus
1007.text: "Yet it was the Lord who ordained that the Toras family would reign over Rizia. And I would not presume to interfere with His plans."

1011.speaker: Player_Romus
1011.text: "My cousin is a tiger without teeth or claws. Leave him his title, and you can have the rest."

1012.speaker: Player_Romus
1012.text: "And yes, that 'authority' includes your own duke."

1013.speaker: Player_Romus
1013.text: "You are even willing to stand up to your own king."

1014.speaker: Player_Romus
1014.text: "Even in a city where fanatical supremacists are allowed to run rampant, you stand your ground."

1015.speaker: Player_Romus
1015.text: "You are coming of age in an era where ordinary Rizians are allowed more representation than ever before."

1022.speaker: Player_Romus
1022.text: "You are growing up at a time when what it means to be 'Rizian' is changing."

1023.speaker: Player_Romus
1023.text: "But we can't forget our history and heritage, even as we hurtle into tomorrow."

1027.speaker: Player_Romus
1027.text: "It is places like Iza that represent the values that our country is fighting for."

1031.speaker: Player_Romus
1031.text: "Yet there are people who stubbornly cling to the unfair hierarchies and constrictive labels of the past."

1032.speaker: Player_Romus
1032.text: "Once we have reconquered Pales, I will turn my attention to the restructuring of Iza's government."

1036.speaker: Player_Romus
1036.text: "Change is at your fingertips. All you need to do is reach out and grasp it."

1037.speaker: Player_Romus
1037.text: "You, the people of Iza, have what it takes to rise up against your oppressors."
1037.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_FrameForWehlenBombing"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_Outcome_MinOppression"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_Outcome_GeneralUnrest"] == Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_Outcome_SuOminaAgainstCrown"] == true)

1041.speaker: Player_Romus
1041.text: "You have voted in a city council that prioritizes the rights of the previously disenfranchised. Use it."

1042.speaker: Player_Romus
1042.text: "Have faith in your ruling house. It may take time, but order will prevail."

1046.speaker: Player_Romus
1046.text: "My cousin is not the problem. It is the flawed system that put him in power."

1050.speaker: Narrator
1050.text: The audience tittered in astonishment. Rico looked even more uncomfortable.

1057.speaker: Player_Romus
1057.text: "Perhaps all of you can learn together what it means to coexist."

1058.speaker: Narrator
1058.text: My remark was greeted by sullen silence.

1059.speaker: Player_Romus
1059.text: "We must find a way to reconcile tradition and modernity. Just as this fine university has done."

1063.speaker: Player_Romus
1063.text: "It was the Lord who ordained that the Toras family would reign over Rizia. And I would not presume to interfere with His plans."

1067.speaker: Player_Romus
1067.text: "Our venerable monarchy has carried us this far. It will carry us further still."

1068.speaker: Player_Romus
1068.text: "We are anchored in gold. Connected to our roots, but looking towards a shining future."

1069.speaker: Narrator
1069.text: A few discontented rumblings came from the audience.

1070.speaker: Narrator
1070.text: There was a smattering of polite applause.

1071.speaker: Player_Romus
1071.text: "Remember, knowledge is your most powerful weapon."

1072.speaker: Player_Romus
1072.text: "Do not underestimate the power of organization. Together, you are greater than the sum of your parts."

1073.speaker: Player_Romus
1073.text: "Do not fall victim to calls for violence. The path of peace will get you further than you expect."

1074.speaker: Player_Romus
1074.text: "I have given you the tools to break free of your chains. It is up to you to use them."

1091.speaker: Narrator
1091.text: Vina rose from her seat and began clapping. There was steel in her eyes.

1092.speaker: Narrator
1092.text: Vina and Manus immediately rose from their seats and began clapping.

1096.speaker: Narrator
1096.text: Manus rose from his seat and began clapping. There was steel in his eyes.

1097.speaker: Narrator
1097.text: The students and teachers assembled rose and began clapping.

1098.speaker: Narrator
1098.text: Before long, the entire auditorium was reverberating with thunderous applause.

1099.speaker: Narrator
1099.text: Rico sat still in his seat. His arms were folded.

1100.speaker: Rico Toras
1100.text: "Forgive me, Your Majesty, but... what the hell was that?"

1101.speaker: Player_Romus
1101.text: "You should be grateful. It was either that or have you deposed."

1102.speaker: Player_Romus
1102.text: "A dose of the truth. Take it or leave it."

1103.speaker: Player_Romus
1103.text: "Just putting on a show for the kids. Don't worry, your job is safe."

1107.speaker: Rico Toras
1107.text: "I assure you that my father won't stand for this."

1108.speaker: Narrator
1108.text: The applause continued as we left our seats and headed toward the banquet that had been prepared in our honor.

1109.speaker: Narrator
1109.text: Rico was right. Hugo wouldn't stand for this.

1110.speaker: Narrator
1110.text: But with Brenas on my side, there was still a chance I could weather the storm.

1111.speaker: Player_Romus
1111.text: "I implore you to hold fast to your identity. Remember the values upon which this nation was built. Only then can we find a way forward."

1115.speaker: Player_Romus
1115.text: "Time and time again, the Toras family has led Rizia out of crisis. With your help, we will do so again."

1116.speaker: Player_Romus
1116.text: "Rizian, Wehzek, Derdian, Valgish -- I call on all subjects of the Crown to unite as one."

1120.speaker: Player_Romus
1120.text: "In times of war, it is crucial we respect our established structures, even if we do not agree with them."

1121.speaker: Player_Romus
1121.text: "In times of instability, it is crucial we respect our established structures, even if we don't agree with them."

1122.speaker: Player_Romus
1122.text: "I ask you to engage in constructive discourse. Do not abandon your convictions, but do not give in to the path of violence, either."

1139.speaker: Narrator
1139.text: Vina sat still. She wasn't applauding at all.

1140.speaker: Narrator
1140.text: Vina and Manus both sat still. They weren't applauding at all.

1144.speaker: Narrator
1144.text: I looked at the House Sazon members in the audience. They weren't applauding.

1145.speaker: Narrator
1145.text: Manus sat still. He wasn't applauding at all.

1146.speaker: Narrator
1146.text: Hesitantly, the students and teachers assembled began clapping.

1149.speaker: Player_Romus
1149.text: "I'm just glad it's over. I can't wait to go home."

1150.speaker: Player_Romus
1150.text: "At least nobody called me a totalist."

1151.speaker: Rico Toras
1151.text: "You know students. They would if they thought they could get away with it."

1152.speaker: Player_Romus
1152.text: "It was either that or have you deposed. Be grateful."

1155.speaker: Rico Toras
1155.text: "You could've tried harder to please your own family."

1156.speaker: Narrator
1156.text: The celebratory speeches wrapped up, and Titus and his guards escorted us out of the auditorium's back entrance.

1157.speaker: Narrator
1157.text: As we were exiting, I noticed a van parked around the corner from the building. Muffled screams were emanating from it.

1158.speaker: Narrator
1158.text: It sounded like the voice of the student who had been dragged away by Su Omina earlier.

1162.speaker: Narrator
1162.text: It sounded like the voice of the student who had shouted at Rico earlier.

1163.speaker: Narrator
1163.text: Titus led us away from the source of the sound towards the university gardens, where a lavish banquet awaited us.

1167.speaker: Narrator
1167.text: I wondered if I had managed to accomplish anything today.

1171.speaker: Narrator
1171.text: A large crowd swarmed in front of the university auditorium entrance.
1171.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn02_FamilyStatues_KingValero"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn02_FamilyStatues_KingValeroAndRomus"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn02_FamilyStatues_TorasFamily"] == true) == false)

1175.speaker: Player_Romus
1175.text: "Just a bit of rabble-rousing. Nothing to worry about."

1187.speaker: Vina Toras
1187.text: "Is there something you're not telling me, Father?"

1214.speaker: Titus Gordion
1214.text: "As your security councilor, I recommend you allow my men to neutralize the offenders before proceeding into the auditorium."

1215.speaker: Player_Romus
1215.text: "Do what you have to. But don't let your new title get to your head."

1221.speaker: Narrator
1221.text: Some were holding a large banner that read "Welcome Home Angelica".

1225.speaker: Narrator
1225.text: I was halfway to the stage when the hall erupted into cheers. I turned my head and  saw a dark-haired woman waving to the crowd. Angelica Sazon.
1225.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.VinaManus_Together"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_HouseSazon_AngelicaPardoned"] == true)

1226.speaker: Narrator
1226.text: Behind him was a dark-haired woman. Angelica.

1233.speaker: Narrator
1233.text: Behind him was a dark-haired woman. Angelica.

1240.speaker: Narrator
1240.text: All eyes turned towards the front row, where Angelica was sitting. Her expression was one of pure disbelief.

1243.speaker: Player_Romus
1243.text: "I now invite Duchess Sazon to join me onstage."

1244.speaker: Narrator
1244.text: I watched her take it all in. Gradually, her incredulity gave way to steely resolve.

1248.speaker: Narrator
1248.text: I watched her take it all in. Gradually, her incredulity gave way to pure joy.

1249.speaker: Narrator
1249.text: I kept my eyes on her as the auditorium reverberated with thunderous applause.

1250.speaker: Narrator
1250.text: Gradually, her incredulity gave way to steely resolve.

1251.speaker: Narrator
1251.text: As she stood up, the auditorium reverberated with thunderous applause.

1255.speaker: Narrator
1255.text: Gradually, her incredulity gave way to pure joy.

1256.speaker: Narrator
1256.text: The auditorium reverberated with thunderous applause as she slowly stood up and made her way towards the stage.

1257.speaker: Narrator
1257.text: I kept my eyes on her as she took her place next to me. Her incredulity had given way to steely resolve.

1261.speaker: Narrator
1261.text: I kept my eyes on her as she took her place next to me. Her incredulity had given way to pure joy.

1286.speaker: Player_Romus
1286.text: "Having said that... there is one problem that needs dealing with right away. Ricardus Toras."

1287.speaker: Player_Romus
1287.text: "Having said that... there is one part of my own heritage that must be dealt with immediately. Your Duke, Ricardus."

1296.speaker: Player_Romus
1296.text: "While the rest of Rizia stays mired in tradition, you dare to imagine a different future."
